game.title: Guilty Party
game.subtitle: 6 in a mansion. 1 is the killer. Evidence can be forged.
htp.title: How to Play
htp.goal:
6 players in a mansion. 1 is the killer (random), the rest are detectives.
• Detectives: Find the killer and vote them out within 3 rounds
• Killer: Survive to round 3, or reduce detective count below 3
htp.phases:
Each round has 3 phases:
1. Investigate (180s): Grab evidence from 7 rooms
2. Trial (120s): Present evidence and accuse
3. Vote (30s): Vote a suspect out, or abstain
htp.evidence:
6 evidence types. 2 are unforgeable 'iron evidence':
• Weapon / Motive / Movement Log / Fingerprint (killer can forge/tamper)
• ★Physical Trace / ★Time Clue (always real)
htp.vision:
Each player has a 170px circle vision; walls block line of sight.
Players outside your vision are hidden.
Witnessing someone frame/tamper/vent → auto iron-level witness note.
htp.killer:
• F Frame: After 5s alone, plant 1 fake evidence (1/round)
• T Tamper: Change document evidence target (1/round)
• X Destroy: Erase 1 evidence, once per game
• Y Fake Testimony: Create 1 fake witness log, once per game
• V Vent: Teleport kitchen ↔ bedroom (30s cooldown)
htp.detective:
• Start with 1 Lens (L to verify truth of evidence; detective only)
• 5 total verifications per game (1 each), no refills
• Verification results are visible to everyone
htp.keys:
WASD/Arrows move · Space search · Tab evidence · L verify
F/T/X/Y killer skills · V vent · M mute · Esc pause
htp.tips:
• Evidence is global-unique — be fast
• Killer screen edges glow red when 2+ detectives watch
• Searched furniture glows gold for 8s — someone was here
• SUSPECTS panel shows 'last seen' — use memory
• Abstain is valid — don't vote blindly
role.assigned_detective: You are a Detective. Find the killer. Beware fake evidence.
role.assigned_killer: You are the Killer. Frame others. Survive all 3 rounds.
evidence.weapon.description: A sharp object — could be the murder weapon.
case.1.name: Mansion Night
case.1.desc: Tutorial — Lord Ashford killed in the study
case.1.intro: Night falls on Ashford Manor. 6 guests, 1 body. Who did it?
case.2.name: The Lady's Mystery
case.2.desc: Standard — Lady Marchmont killed in her bedroom
case.2.intro: Lady Marchmont died at midnight. The killer can now tamper with documents...
case.3.name: Death of the Doctor
case.3.desc: Advanced — Dr. Sinclair killed in the library
case.3.intro: Dr. Sinclair found dead in the library. The killer can now destroy evidence...
tut.1.welcome: Welcome to Guilty Party. Your role appears in the top-left.
tut.2.move: Use WASD or arrow keys to move between 7 rooms.
tut.3.search: Press Space/E to search for evidence (4s).
tut.4.book: Press Tab to open the evidence book.
tut.5.trial: Investigation ends. Trial begins. Each player has 20s.
tut.6.present: Select evidence + press Enter to present and accuse.
tut.7.lens: You have the lens! Press L to verify a piece of evidence.
tut.8.vote: Vote out the suspect, or abstain. Majority = elimination. No majority = no one out.
win.detective: Detectives win! The killer was caught.
win.killer: Killer wins! You survived to the end.
ai.speech.lens_real: {name}: This is real, I verified it.
ai.speech.lens_fake: {name}: This is fake. The lens shows it.
